prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A reasonable first call is **Business Needs Craftsmanship**. The BBB listing shows it as accredited with an A+ rating and lists kitchen and bathroom remodels, additions, basement work, deck repair, and general home repair among its services. It serves Joplin and nearby areas; the listed phone number is **(816) 599-1292**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/business-needs-craftsmanship-0734-1000011969)

For a broader remodel or construction project, **American Construction Inc.** is another Joplin-area option listed by the BBB with an A+ rating: **(417) 781-6811**. [BBB contractor listings](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/category/general-contractor)

BBB ratings are only one signal, not a guarantee. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent references and proof of liability insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, payment schedule, and change-order terms.
